### [`fighter_piece0_tail`](../../../../src/leftovers/leftover_083f.asm#L6) `$083F`

*data*

Last byte of the slot of piece 0. Piece number 0 means no piece, so nothing reads this slot. The crack colour copier at $0810-$083e is not in the program.
